title: Delivery Policy
body:
**Delivery: £5 per order.**

We deliver within the United Kingdom. [[TO COMPLETE: confirm whether you deliver outside the UK]]

### How delivery works
- The delivery charge and your final order total are confirmed by message before your order is accepted.
- The website has no checkout. Nothing is charged until we confirm your order by message.
- Delivery times vary by product and are confirmed for your specific order. We do not guarantee a delivery date unless we have confirmed it to you in writing.

### Couriers and tracking
[[TO COMPLETE: name the courier(s) you use and whether tracking is provided]]

### Problems with delivery
If your parcel is late, damaged or missing, message us with your order details and we will help.
